decision: The interrupted NEW run prep1-revalidation-20260921T211017Z preserves independently verified case bundles and complete H/build commands, but its published folder has no top-level MATRIX-COMMAND record. Actual command timing, resource usage and full outer command metadata cannot be reconstructed from individual case results. Execute the frozen matrix once with complete capture; retain previous new-run evidence as supplemental. This does not reopen retrieval of lost original PREP-1 records.

source_closure.verification: All materialized executable/build/helper/controller source and project bytes independently matched their GitHub I Git blobs, byte counts and SHA256s before execution. No mocks or replacement modules. Entire local closure will be recorded before and after each command.
source_closure.scope: Exact executable closure, not a full Git checkout. Global implementation equivalence is additionally checked with GitHub commit/tree comparison. The complete real-H command remains independently verified under its own prior NEW run identity; it will not be rerun.

observer.scope: Evidence-only observer, not implementation. Full observer source is included in each command record. One subprocess invocation, full file-backed stdout/stderr, actual start/end/exit, wall time, waited child CPU/rusage, boot/host identity, source and build identities.

execution_policy: Build once using committed harmless script and unchanged exact pins. Publish/read back complete build record before matrix. Run full frozen matrix once; preserve any failure without weakening or repeated-until-green execution. Retain complete per-case raw evidence and post-run cleanup observations. Publish complete independently decodable units, not missing multipart tails.
